metadata.title: Non-convex unit-edge polytopes on kissing configurations in dimensions 5-7
metadata.abstract: All nine known conjecturally optimal non-lattice kissing configurations in dimensions 5, 6, and 7 are the vertex sets of polytopes with only unit edges. Eight of the nine are non-convex, and the contact polytopes, the convex hulls of the same points, have longer edges. The edges of the unit-edge polytopes are exactly the contacts of the configuration. All but two of the nine are constructed from the lattice contact polytope in the same dimension by splitting some of its facets and reassembling the pieces. This is a geometric construction, distinct from the constructions by layers. The facets that fold when split are consecutive members of the Gosset series $k_{21}$, and a split in dimension $n$ folds to the inner product $1/(10-n)$: $1/5$, $1/4$, or $1/3$. These are the inner products by which the contact polytopes differ from the lattice one. All 12 unit-edge polytopes, the nine and the three lattice ones, are creased, a class we define that extends convexity by admitting shallow folds that reach no more than halfway. Each is the only creased unit-edge polytope on its vertex set. Every statement is certified in exact arithmetic.
metadata.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Ancillary files contain the verification code and data (Python standard library only)

analysis.progressType: 精确认证的多胞体构造
analysis.workSummary: 为五至七维已知猜测最优的非格 kissing 配置构造单位边多胞体，解释其与格配置的切割重组关系，并用精确算术认证所述几何性质。
analysis.breakthrough: 揭示多数非凸单位边模型及其 creased 唯一性结构。
analysis.limitations: 配置的最优性仍是猜测；精确认证几何性质不构成 kissing number 的最优性证明。 本次依据官方公告摘要分析，尚未核查正文和完整证明；未见披露仅指当前已读摘要与作者评论。
analysis.priorityReason: 适合球堆积与计算几何方向，附属代码有复现价值。
